budget_items.what_was_recorded: Business was uninsured for workers compensation from April 28 to June 9, 2017; Board members said staff time spent following up is a cost to the community.
budget_items.quote: it is a cost to us as a community and she would like to impose some type of penalty

budget_items.quote: this will create a shortfall of $4,546.98 to the town budget.

budget_items.quote: coa director doherty has earmarked $6,000 for fiscal year 2018 from formula grant funding.
